title: Standby AI Studio
description: All-in-one live stage and event console for MCs, DJs and hosts: an audio soundboard, a teleprompter script, live timers, DJ cues and a companion scorekeeper. A React 19 progressive web app talks to Fastify microservices on Google Cloud Run, with Gemini and Lyria for AI help and generated audio. Access is invite-only with Google sign-in.
